description: Momentum effects are stronger in smaller, less-analyzed stocks due to slower information diffusion and higher limits to arbitrage; restricting to top3000 (ex-top1000) should capture this small-cap momentum premium; falsified if forward Sharpe is not higher than the comparable top500 63d skip 0 strategy (currently -4.14).
title: Small-Cap Momentum · 63d skip 0 · Top 3000 · Long Only
